import { afterEach, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'
import { cleanup, fireEvent, render, screen } from '@testing-library/react'
import '@testing-library/jest-dom/vitest'
import { App } from './App'
import { StatusBadge } from './StatusBadge'
import { SyncIndicator } from './SyncIndicator'

afterEach(() => {
  cleanup()
  vi.useRealTimers()
})

it('renders panel controls and selection highlights immediately', () => {
  vi.useFakeTimers()
  render(<App />)
  const priority = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Priority only' })
  const compact = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Compact' })
  const panel = screen.getByRole('main')
  expect(screen.getByTestId('folder-inbox')).toHaveClass('is-active')
  expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'List' })).toHaveClass('is-active')

  for (const active of [true, false]) {
    fireEvent.click(priority)
    fireEvent.click(compact)
    expect(priority.classList.contains('is-active')).toBe(active)
    expect(compact.classList.contains('is-active')).toBe(active)
    expect(panel.classList.contains('compact')).toBe(active)
    expect(compact).toHaveAttribute('aria-pressed', String(active))
  }

  fireEvent.click(screen.getByTestId('folder-sent'))
  expect(screen.getByTestId('folder-sent')).toHaveClass('is-active')
  expect(screen.getByTestId('folder-inbox')).not.toHaveClass('is-active')

  fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Preview' }))
  expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Preview' })).toHaveClass('is-active')
  expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'List' })).not.toHaveClass('is-active')
  const search = screen.getByRole('searchbox')
  fireEvent.focus(search)
  expect(search).toHaveClass('is-focused')
  fireEvent.blur(search)
  expect(search).not.toHaveClass('is-focused')
})

it('renders unread and online styles immediately when props change', () => {
  vi.useFakeTimers()
  const { rerender } = render(<><StatusBadge count={2} /><SyncIndicator online /></>)
  expect(screen.getByTestId('unread-badge')).toHaveClass('has-unread')
  expect(screen.getByRole('status')).toHaveClass('is-online')
  rerender(<><StatusBadge count={0} /><SyncIndicator online={false} /></>)
  expect(screen.getByTestId('unread-badge')).not.toHaveClass('has-unread')
  expect(screen.getByRole('status')).not.toHaveClass('is-online')
})

item.text: I found a gap: the tests catch delays in today’s components, but don’t prevent a new component from mutating `classList`. I’ll add a lint rule that directs contributors to derive `className` during render, then prove it rejects the historical helper and `ViewToggle`.

item.text:
Added lint enforcement for the repeated DOM-class mutation pattern. Its error directs contributors to derive `className` from props/state during render.

Proved it rejects both historical mistakes: `deferVisualClass` and `ViewToggle`. Removing the helper alone allowed reintroduction; types cannot enforce render timing.

Updated `AGENTS.md`. All project checks pass. Changes remain uncommitted because `.git` is read-only.
